phrase.zh: 把微弱的讯号，认真听清。
phrase.en: Listen closely to a faint signal.

visual.zh: 碟形天线朝向天空，用“聆听”比喻对不可见电磁波的接收。射电望远镜并不是直接收听太空里的声音，图中的波纹也是视觉转译。
visual.en: A dish points skyward, using listening as a metaphor for receiving invisible electromagnetic waves. Radio telescopes do not directly hear sound in space; the ripples are a visual translation.

background.zh: 美国国家射电天文台的甚大阵由 27 面天线组成，沿 Y 形排列。不同天线的信号以电子方式合并，使阵列能够分辨比单面天线更细的天空结构。画面表达的是协同观测，并不是该阵列的现场照片。
background.en: The NRAO Very Large Array consists of 27 antennas in a Y-shaped layout. Their signals are combined electronically to resolve finer structures than a single antenna could. This illustration evokes coordinated observation rather than documenting the actual site.
